description: CfAT (Centre for Appropriate Technology) Mobile Phone Hotspots on NT Highways is a dataset listed in Northern Territory Government open data portal (data.nt.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Corporate and Digital Development. This dataset provides the GPS Co-ordinates of CfAT Mobile Phone Hotspots on highways in the Northern Territory. Coverage: Northern Territory. The portal files it under the publisher Corporate and Digital Development. Its tags are Centre for Appropriate Technology, CfAT Mobbile Phone Hotspots, Mobile Phone Hotspots NT Highways. It offers 2 resource(s) in pdf, xlsx. The portal shows 2022-07-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-nt-government-open-data-portal.
